svg.title: roadstar-data: Everyone's dispatch data, merged into one shared table
svg.desc: Fixed options and rounded numbers only · all public · withdraw any time. Opt in once off by default → Auto send one Issue per run → Checked twice local + workflow → Weekly merge Sun 00:00 JST → Ship it everyone updates

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
